name.zh: 扶椅站姿单腿腘绳肌拉伸

purpose.en: Stretch the back of your thigh while standing.

text.zh: 脚跟着地脚尖勾起，从髋部稍微前折
text.en: Heel down, toes up, and hinge forward a little from your hips

text.zh: 一手扶稳椅子，支撑腿膝盖微屈
text.en: Hold a stable chair with one hand and soften the standing knee.

text.zh: 腰背保持中立，前腿膝盖不过伸
text.en: Keep your back neutral and do not overextend the front knee.

commonErrors.en: Rounding the back to reach down.

cautions.zh: 大腿后侧疼痛或发麻时减小幅度，仍不适就停止
cautions.en: Ease off if the back of your thigh hurts or tingles, and stop if it continues.
